episodes.title: Overflow
episodes.summary: When 15-year-old Asa loses her parents to an accident, she's taken in by her strange aunt, Makio.

episodes.title: Wrap
episodes.summary: Makio's friend visits to meet Asa. Later, Makio meets with an old acquaintance for some advice.

episodes.title: Discard
episodes.summary: Makio and Asa return home to sort through her family's belongings, and Asa attends middle school graduation.

episodes.title: Cower
episodes.summary: Asa begins high school as Makio grapples with the new responsibilities of being her guardian.

episodes.title: Decide
episodes.summary: Asa struggles to choose an extracurricluar activity as she recalls old memories of Minori.

episodes.title: Overlap
episodes.summary: As Asa enters summer break, Makio finds herself growing closer with Kasamachi-kun.

episodes.title: Leave in Writing
episodes.summary: As Makio weighs what to do with Minori's journal, she meets Emiri's mother and learns of Minori's past.

episodes.title: Wander
episodes.summary: After discovering Minori's journal, Asa begins skipping school, prompting Makio to search for her.

episodes.title: Intersect
episodes.summary: Asa returns to school and tries her hand at writing lyrics, while Makio battles writer's block.

episodes.title: Bind
episodes.summary: Asa continues working on original lyrics while her classmates face struggles of their own at school.

episodes.title: Set Free
episodes.summary: With Valentine's Day approaching and no Valentine, Asa asks others about their plans in hopes of chocolate.

episodes.title: Find
episodes.summary: Asa auditions as her band's vocalist. Meanwhile, Makio and Michiko meet up while Kasamachi runs into Tono.

episodes.title: Morning is Here
episodes.summary: A chance meeting at the station leads Asa to invite Chiyo to her band club's upcoming performance.
